title: 15Oct-Valedictory & Nation Builder-News-Coverage
summary: 15th October - Valedictory Function & Prize Distribution and Nation Builder Awards 2026 to 12 Teachers at Bahai Centre.
description:
15th October - Valedictory Function & Prize Distribution and Nation Builder Awards 2026 to 12 Teachers at Bahai Centre.
The programme received excellent coverage across both print and digital media, giving our Club’s work wonderful visibility and recognition.
Covered in following newspapers - Tehelka Samachar – Thane (17 Oct), Kokan Sakal (17th Oct), Yuva Stambh News,
